method: Actual initial living infected IDs and admitted transforms, before any input/tick. Read-only deterministic placement replay associates accepted source cohorts using the same static navigation and rejection rules; each actual actor/home position is retained alongside requested placement. Actual positions are assigned to the nearest authored street row and column, so every city band is represented without a fabricated3m road width. Cohort size uses actual IDs from that cohort, no visual clustering threshold. Source quotas100/150 are stricter than the row minimum60/90.
